baseline.plan: Read current checkout owner at the cited lines; compare the unchanged implementation with the narrowly defined source mechanism. Existing dirty work is preserved.

evidence.note: Individual full-section source/current-owner audit with scoped disposition and falsifier.

record.hypothesis: The x264 source contains one type-6 SEI NAL. Removing type 6 leaves 90/90 VCL hashes, complete decoded-frame hashes and packet timing unchanged. The file shrinks from 116,070 to 115,381 bytes (689 bytes). Chromium presents all 90 frames with zero drops. This does not authorize indiscriminate SEI stripping. HDR/mastering data, timing, orientation and any other requested semantics must remain part of admission.
limits: First-pass SOURCE_REVIEW only; historical report executions were read, not independently rerun.
No missing raw evidence archive is treated as a missing definition.
No production change, build, timing run, qualification or default routing change.

excluded_costs: No browser/component execution performed in this audit.
measurement.primary_metric: Removed bytes and complete packet-processing cost on explicitly eligible metadata.
measurement.result: No new quantitative measurement; historical report values remain reported evidence only.
measurement.uncertainty: Source applicability does not establish runtime correctness, speed, physical energy or release readiness.
measurement.worthwhile_change: A concrete removed cost or capability under this exact contract, sufficient to justify the next bounded experiment; no global percentage gate.

record.next_test: Reopen only for a positively identified redundant encoder annotation subtype and useful transfer cost; compare VCL, decoded output, timing and retained HDR/timing metadata.
